packageRules.description: Keep @types/vscode at engines.vscode: vsce refuses to package when the types are newer than the oldest supported VS Code, so both move together by hand
Hold TypeScript below 7: typescript-eslint refuses to load on TS 7 until typescript-eslint/typescript-eslint#10940 lands
Hold mocha below 12: it is ESM-only, and the extension host of VS Code 1.90, the oldest engines.vscode admits, cannot require it
